events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-10-31 Canelo Álvarez vs Christian Mbilli
events.strDescriptionEN: Christian Mbilli defends the WBC super middleweight title against former undisputed champion Canelo Álvarez in Riyadh. Mbilli enters unbeaten and brings relentless pressure and power, while Canelo returns looking to reclaim world-champion status at 168 pounds. The matchup pits one of boxing’s biggest stars against one of the division’s most dangerous unbeaten champions.
events.strResult: Canelo Alvarez defeated Christian Mbilli by unanimous decision in Riyadh to regain the WBC super middleweight title. After a competitive opening, Canelo took control through the middle and later rounds with his defense, accuracy and experience. The judges scored the fight 115-112, 116-111 and 117-110 in his favour.
